name: Baobab Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as baobabventures.vc, the operator-led, remote-first pre-seed and seed fund of Carles Reina (ElevenLabs GTM lead), launched Nov 2025 with a $15M solo GP fund (Tech.eu). Its site lists Theker Robotics, Omina, Murphy AI and Altan AI. Not Baobab Capital or other firms named Baobab (e.g. Africa-focused funds).

conflicts.reason: Only the month of the Omnia blog post date is recorded; the other dates come from search summaries, not fetched pages.

open_items: Only 1 round recorded with a page that names Baobab Ventures as an investor. Altan (Sep 2025, $2.5M pre-seed) is named as Baobab-backed only via a search-result summary of Preqin; fetched pages not confirmed. THEKER's $85M Series A (Pulse 2.0) names Carles Reina as an individual with Baobab Ventures as his affiliation, not the firm as participant, so not recorded.
Murphy AI and Wabi AI round details not found. Pulse 2.0 says seven investments, four named.
HQ: Tech.eu says London and Barcelona-based; the firm's site says remote-first and states no HQ. City recorded as London per the lead list.
Check size is Tech.eu's reported average ($300K-$350K), not a stated range on the firm's site. Fund close date is the announcement date; fund has no number (debut fund).
Application URL is the homepage contact form; team contact address on the site not recorded.
